body.statement: If \(H=\{s_{\emptyset}\}\), every selector gate is laid back on \(E_H\), and \(S\) has no latent root shared with \(V\), then \(G_H^N\) is the ordinary semi-Markovian expansion on \(V\), \(\Phi_H\) equals its ordinary observational-target relation, and \(\operatorname{SA\mbox{-}CS\mbox{-}ID}\) reduces to the ID formula-or-hedge classification of Shpitser and Pearl.
body.justification: The structural and positive-recursion reduction is established, but the theorem's full formula-or-hedge certificate claim still requires a verifier-level hedge compiler.
body.gap: Classical hedge existence does not immediately imply the required strictly positive rational-affine canonical response-table box for arbitrary finite alphabets.
body.consumer: Implementers may regression-test graph normalization and successful formulas against ordinary ID, but should not yet treat every failed ordinary run as carrying the strengthened global-twin box.
body.proof_tex:
Exact support \(H=\{s_{\emptyset}\}\) gives
\[
 P_\theta(S=s_{\emptyset})=1.
\tag{25}
\]
At \(s_{\emptyset}\), every selector gate is laid back, so its known multiplexer selects the natural structural equation rather than an override. Since \(S\) shares no latent root with \(V\), deleting the deterministic selector coordinate removes neither a substantive latent parent nor an independence constraint among substantive roots. Support-active normalization substitutes the constant gate arguments but retains every natural response coordinate and every substantive latent-root law. The resulting recursive equations and root factorization are therefore exactly those of the ordinary semi-Markovian expansion on \(V\).

For each substantive cell \(v\), (25) yields
\[
 p_\theta(V=v,S=s_{\emptyset})=p_\theta(V=v).
\tag{26}
\]
Intervening to set \(S=s_{\emptyset}\) changes no laid-back gate, so the normalized target is the ordinary \(do(A=a)\) target. Applying \(\textnormal{thm:normalization-equivalence}\) to (26) proves that, after suppressing the constant selector coordinate, \(\Phi_H\) equals the ordinary observational--target relation.

There is no active override context, hence no selector-correction token is required. The reachability test remaining in \(\textnormal{def:fixing-transition}\) is
\[
 \operatorname{dis}_{D}(W)\cap\operatorname{de}_{D}(W)=\{W\},
\]
the ordinary CADMG fixing criterion, and its successor is the ordinary quotient \(K_D/\sum_{x_W}K_D\). The two tests in \(\textnormal{def:elimination-transition}\) are respectively marginalization over a nonempty set of nonancestors and factorization over proper districts; their emitted circuits are the ordinary sum and topologically ordered district factors. Consequently every admitted nonresidual step is algebraically its ordinary counterpart.

The residual lists are merely finite encoded lists in the frozen definitions; no frozen premise states that they contain every ordinary ID formula or every hedge witness. The proved conclusion is therefore the exact structural and transition-level reduction, without the unproved residual-classification assertion.

obligation.what_is_open: Compile every ordinary ID hedge into the exact residual contrast representation required by the frozen verifier.
obligation.obstruction: Classical ID completeness supplies a hedge witness but the present negative certificate is stronger: it requires fixed canonical response tables, independent-root factorization, rational-affine dependence on one open rational box, strict positivity of every admissible observed cell, exact support, and an encoded coefficient-bound sign certificate. A common-baseline mixture is not automatically legal because coordinatewise mixing through a polynomial SCM can destroy observed-law equality.
obligation.attempted: The structural normalization and every nonresidual ID operation were reduced exactly, and successful ordinary formulas are projection candidates. The hedge route was not declared proved because no induction was obtained that simultaneously preserves the full observed law through arbitrary observed descendants and keeps a nonzero target contrast under the required positive rational perturbation.
obligation.partial_result: When \(H=\{s_{\emptyset}\}\), exact support gives \(p_\theta(S=s_{\emptyset})=1\). Every gate is laid back, and absence of a latent root shared by \(S\) and \(V\) permits deletion of the constant selector coordinate without changing any substantive root factorization. Hence \(G_H^N\) is the ordinary semi-Markovian expansion, \(p_\theta(v,s_{\emptyset})=p_\theta(v)\), and normalization equivalence identifies \(\Phi_H\) with the ordinary observational-target relation. The compiler's nonresidual ancestor, district, and fixing operations are then exactly the ordinary ID operations. A successful ordinary ID formula is encoded by the projection side of \(\textnormal{lem:published-trace-scheduling}\). The unproved part is the failing side: a hedge must still be compiled into the verifier's rational-affine, strictly positive, arbitrary-finite-alphabet global-twin box.
